title: El Nido vs Siargao: Which Should You Visit?
verdict: El Nido for jaw-dropping scenery and world-class lagoons, Siargao for surfing, nightlife, and easier access. Do both with 12+ days.

categories.name: Beaches & Scenery
categories.summary: El Nido's limestone karst and emerald lagoons are world-class. Siargao is beautiful but flatter.

categories.name: Island Hopping
categories.summary: El Nido's 4 tour routes with lagoons are a bucket-list experience. Siargao has pleasant day trips but less spectacular.

categories.name: Surfing
categories.summary: Cloud 9 is the Philippines' best wave. El Nido has no meaningful surf.

categories.name: Cost
categories.summary: Siargao is cheaper overall — cheaper flights, accommodation, and food.

categories.name: Getting There
categories.summary: Budget direct flights from Manila make Siargao dramatically easier to reach.

categories.name: Nightlife
categories.summary: General Luna has a genuine bar strip. El Nido winds down by midnight.

categories.name: Best Time to Visit
categories.summary: Both share Nov–Apr dry season. Siargao has a surf peak Aug–Nov but typhoon risk.

categories.name: Where to Stay
categories.summary: Both offer good options. Siargao slightly better value per peso.

categories.name: Food & Dining
categories.summary: Both have excellent fresh seafood. Siargao has better cafe culture.

categories.name: Overall Vibe
categories.summary: El Nido: romantic, nature-first. Siargao: social, surfer-nomad energy.

faq.question: Is El Nido or Siargao better for first-time visitors?
faq.answer: Non-surfers lean El Nido for the visuals; social travelers lean Siargao for the vibe. With 10+ days, do both.

faq.question: Which is cheaper, El Nido or Siargao?
faq.answer: Siargao — cheaper flights from Manila, lower accommodation costs, and slightly cheaper food.

faq.question: When is the best time to visit?
faq.answer: November to April (dry season) for both. Siargao's surf peaks August–November but typhoon risk is real then.
